title: Figure 2: Probability density function of N, number of ET civilizations in the Galaxy
description: Plot titled 'PROBABILITY DENSITY FUNCTION OF N' with 'Prob. density function of N' (0 to 6x10^-4) versus 'N = Number of ET Civilizations in Galaxy' (0-4000). Captioned 'Figure 2. Comparing the Two Probability Density Functions of the Random Variable N Found (1) Without Resorting to the CLT at All (thick curve) and (2) Using the CLT and the Relevant Lognormal Approximation (thin curve).' Text cites a mean of about 4590 communicating civilizations from the statistical Drake equation.
